description: Eight Markdown fences — circuit, breadboard, perfboard, copper, vna, scope, spectrum, graph — drawn in the preview and edited by dragging
command.movePart: Move a Circuit Part by Address
command.movePoint: Move a Circuit Node by Address
config.noteFrame: In the Fence Editor, draw a frame around notes: text (off by default).
config.problemsErc: Also list ERC findings (places that would not work as built) in the Problems panel. Off by default: a board still being wired reports every unconnected leg.
config.oldNoteFrame.deprecated: Renamed to tommieFence.map.noteFrame (this name is still read).
config.imageAfterFence: How the preview shows an image that sits right after a fence, alone in its paragraph. Such an image is usually a copy of the same figure for GitHub, which does not draw fences.
config.imageAfterFence.collapse: Fold it under a closed heading (open it to compare).
config.imageAfterFence.hide: Leave it out of the preview.
config.imageAfterFence.show: Show it as written (the figure appears twice).
